open_points.subject: OperationBinding binding_id creation
open_points.text: `store` builds it over its own connection inside the transaction it opened, and keeps everything a row operation does not say: opening, committing and rolling back the transaction, the order of store positions, attempt numbers and minted identities / `module:bindings` computes `record_digest` of the one capability entry with `capability:canonical_values.content_identity` (A08 rule 2), mints `binding_id` (A01 rule 2) and writes the Binding `proposed`
open_points.question: Does `module:store` mint `binding_id` atomically during the record change, or does `module:bindings` mint it before writing?
options: `store` mints and returns the identity as part of `record_change`
`bindings` mints the identity and passes it to `store`
open_points.default_guess: Have `store` mint and return `binding_id` atomically with the Binding insertion.

open_points.subject: TrialExecution file-output disclosure class
open_points.text: for a `file` port only its facts — digest, size and media type, no bytes and never a StoredValue / `module:functions` stores the value outputs through `capability:store.put_value_bytes` and records a file output by its facts only (M07), each with the highest class of the case's inputs
open_points.question: Does a TrialExecution file-output entry persist a disclosure class in addition to digest, size and media type, or is that class only derived from the trial case's inputs when read?
options: Keep only digest, size and media type and derive the class
Add disclosure_class to each file-output entry
open_points.default_guess: Keep the M07 file facts unchanged and derive the class from the case inputs.

open_points.subject: Captured spooled-file handoff
open_points.text: the spooled input files cross into the content-addressed area through `module:store` and become digests; from `module:runs` to `module:functions` the record's executed implementation, the contract version named, the record's inputs and those digests / `module:functions` reads that implementation's own record and checks that its contract version is the one named, fits each value with `capability:canonical_values.fit_port_value` and each file by its facts against `trial_fixture_bytes_max` (A04 rule 1), and only then copies each spooled file into the content-addressed area
open_points.question: Does `runs` copy the files first and pass digests to `functions`, or does it pass complete SpooledFile references so `functions` can check them and perform the copy afterward?
options: Pass SpooledFile references; `functions` checks and copies
`runs` copies first and passes resulting digests
open_points.default_guess: Pass complete SpooledFile references to `functions`; copy them only after all capture checks pass.
